referenceFunction.generalComment:
This dataset represents the supply of 1 megajoule of heat in a residence, by synthetic natural gas from catalytic methanation combustion in a boiler. The synthetic natural gas from catalytic methanation is produced by Electrolysis, PEM, with electricity from grid as feedstock. The carbon is sourced from DAC. Heat conversion efficiency [% LHV input]: 109.5%. LHV [MJ/kg]: 48. Market price [Euro/MJ]: 0.03. Distribution loss [% output]: 0.02%. Storage loss [% output]: 0%. CO2 biogenic share [%]: 100%. Power [kW]: 16.4. Lifetime [years]: 20. Annual operation [hours]: 2100. : . For more information, refer to: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023. Source: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023.
